Smt. Baby Devi vs State Of U.P. on 12 February, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:23991
Court No. - 91

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22223 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Baby Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Vashisth,Shyam Sunder
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned counsel for the informant, learned Aga for
opposite party no.1 and perused the material placed on record.

2. This present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 263 of 2020,
under Sections 498A, 304B, 120-B of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station
Hasayan, District Hathras with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text:
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station
Hasayan, District Hathras
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant is innocent and has been falsely
implicated in this case.

It is  submitted that during trial three prosecution witnesses such as P.W. 1 father, P.W. 2 mother , P.W. 3 Ram Sewak, brother of deceased have not corroborated the version of prosecution and declared hostile.

It is further submitted that similarly placed co-accused, namely,
Rakesh Kumar @ Rajesh and Kusma Devi have already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 16.03.2023 and 21.04.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 27414 of 2021 and 17910 of 2021 respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 27414 of 2021 and 17910 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The name of co-accused Ram Sewak and Rakesh Kumar were also disclosed by the deceased during her dying declaration.

Applicant is Smt. Baby Devi vs State Of U.P. on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58667793/
1 languishing in jail since 16.01.2021.

entities.text: Smt. Baby Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case, the appellant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. assisted by the learned counsel for the respondent have supported the order passed by the Sessions court and vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the appellant but could not dispute the fact that co-accused Ram Sewak and Rakesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantSmt. Baby Devi in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 12.2.2024 SY  Smt. Baby Devi vs State Of U.P. on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58667793/
